CONTROL PANEL

 FIELD GUIDE / 001

STAY QUIET.
STAY ALIVE.

Explore four connected stages. Recover fuses in the Lobby, activate Poolroom relays, release Pipework valves, and recover Red Archive tapes. Each exit saves a checkpoint. Pause and choose Save and return to menu to keep your current expedition on this device. Continue restores its difficulty, supplies, score and research progress. Choose Guided start for a short playable introduction, or start at any stage from the menu.

01

Sprinting makes noise. Break line of sight, crouch, and let your stamina recover.

02

The Smiler follows light. The Hound follows sound. The Watcher freezes while you face it with your flashlight on. Sahur follows both sight and sound.

03

Your flashlight is your main light source. Flood is wide and efficient; Focus reaches farther; Boost is strongest but drains faster and overheats. Objectives recharge it. Optional supply boxes refill stamina, battery, and one decoy. Use the scanner for a bearing; the survey map records visible corridors, landmarks and your trail. Pin a waypoint to trace a route through charted passages.

04

Hold E (or the touch E button) to open a machine terminal. Route both Poolroom branches to their marked values; balance Pipeworks inlet and outlet pressure. At the Archive exit, decode the tape signals, then hold E for eight seconds to transmit your escape signal. Stay still until the control completes. Glimpses, phantom doors, pressure bursts and other visions are survivable; a close-range entity attack is fatal. Sector signs, local junction guides and room silhouettes help you navigate. Bypass routes give you a second way out. Jumpscares can be disabled.

05

Hold V or the WIND button while stationary to recover up to 25% battery. Cranking uses stamina and attracts sound hunters. Release the control and press F if the lamp was off. Pause freezes battery use and heat.

06

The stun projector is optional and difficult to obtain: unlock three remote research cases, then return to the assembly bench near the starting corridor. Hold E to extract each part and assemble. You get three charges; aim within 12 m. Each hit stuns for 8 seconds. Misses consume charges. The pulse makes noise.

07

Ballerina Cappuccina slows in your beam. Brri Brri Bicus Dicus Bombicus plants its feet before charging. Step out of its line during the wind-up, then move past while it recovers. Spioniro Golubiro alerts nearby enemies. Bombardino Crocodilo patrols by sight. Stun effects work on all eight entities.

08

Objectives change the building. Lobby fuses restore local lights. Poolroom relays lower the water; two relays reveal the Maintenance drain passage. Pipeworks valves reduce steam; two valves open the Boiler pressure bypass. Archive tapes restore a connected sequence of survival clues on the signal receivers. These optional shortcuts can help you escape a chase.

09

Save and return to menu preserves your current position, objectives and resources. Continue resumes that expedition. A retry restarts the current stage from its checkpoint, with the score and equipment you brought into it.

Sahur tracks sight and sound. Patrols look forward: crouch behind them, keep your distance, and listen for their direction.
